purpose: Buff reference for AOBuddy10 Doctor decision-making. The Doctor is the game's healer, so the load-bearing section of this file is givesToOthers: what a team or raid actually wants from a Doctor, every ladder enumerated with its real cast requirement so a bot can pick the right rung. selfBuffs covers what the Doctor keeps on itself, wantedFromOthers what it should ask for, and botStrategyNotes the cast order and the nanoline traps.

dataSources.selfAndGivesIds: AOBuddy/GameData/profiles/doctor-nanos.json (nanos.ocp extraction, client 18.8.50_EP1; 240 castable nanos). Every id below marked source=local was read from that file, with its castReqs quoted verbatim. Names re-verified against the extracted client data/itemnames.sql.
dataSources.crossProfAndGeneral: wiki.aodb.us Who_Buffs_What, wiki.aodb.us Doctor_Nano_Programs, ao-universe.com, forums.funcom.com. Cross-profession buff ids are NOT in the local Doctor data (they are other professions' nanos) so those ids are null and marked source=web.
dataSources.teamHpBuffVsTeamHealSplit: DERIVED FROM THE LOCAL DATA, not from a website. doctor-nanos.json lumps 54 nanos under 'Heals - Team'. They split cleanly on their cast requirements: 16 carry a SpaceTime requirement alongside BM+MM and are the TEAM HP BUFF line (wiki.aodb.us nanoline 184, 'Enhance Team Health ... Superior Omni-Med Enhancement'); the other 38 carry only BM+MM and are the TEAM HEAL ladder. Both families cast via TeamCastNano children, which is why the extractor could not tell them apart.

selfBuffs.name: Improved Instinctive Control
selfBuffs.effect: Nano C. Init +350, Nano Resist +75, Max Nano Energy +300.
selfBuffs.note: The single most valuable self-buff a Doctor runs: Nano C. Init is cast AND recharge speed on the heal ladder, which is the Doctor's throughput. Same nanoline as Instinctive Control (28669) - it REPLACES it, never stacks. Requires Shadowlands. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Instinctive Control
selfBuffs.effect: Nano C. Init +200, Nano Resist +25, Max Nano Energy +150.
selfBuffs.note: The froob / pre-SL version. Use until Improved is castable, then never again (same nanoline). source=local

selfBuffs.name: Improved Nano Repulsor
selfBuffs.note: Nano Resist is cost factor 1.2 for a Doctor (cheap) and this buff doubles down on it. It is what stops a Trader draining you or a mob landing a debuff mid-heal. Replaces Nano Repulsor (28671, +92) - same nanoline. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Nano Repulsor
selfBuffs.note: Superseded by Improved Nano Repulsor (same nanoline). source=local

selfBuffs.name: Superior First Aid
selfBuffs.note: Self-cast Treatment is how a Doctor equips implants and symbiants above its raw skill, and self-cast First Aid raises the QL of the stims that cover it while a heal recharges. Best in a 3-step line: Specialist Treatment 28674 (+35 Treatment / +20 First Aid), Enhanced First Aid 28657 (+10 Treatment / +15 First Aid). Same nanoline - only the best applies. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Iron Circle
selfBuffs.note: Cast on yourself AND the whole team. The Stamina matters twice over for a Doctor because its own endgame armor is Stamina-gated (Ofab Doctor QL300 needs Stamina 1099). Replaces Enlarge (28658, +10/+10 plus Scale +8) - same nanoline. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Enlarge
selfBuffs.note: The low-level Iron Circle. Same nanoline (156 per Who_Buffs_What) - do not try to stack them. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Continuous Reconstruction
selfBuffs.note: Best of a 4-step heal-delta line: Hearty Constitution 222855 (+48), Cellular Restoration 28651 (+25), Natural Healing 28663 (+10). Same nanoline, only the best applies. This is the line that needs Matter Creation - which is why a pure-healing Doctor still cannot skip MC. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Life Channeler
selfBuffs.effect: Max Health +1344, and casts child nano 144660 (the heal for the amount raised).
selfBuffs.note: Top of the 14-step SHORT (single-target) HP buff line. AOWiki: these 'raise the max HP of the target and heal the amount of HP raised', lasting up to 8 minutes 20 seconds. Cast on yourself before a pull and on whoever is about to be hit. Whole line, ascending: Health Augmentation 96248 (+57), Survivability Booster 96249 (+118), Health Surge 96250 (+221), Bodily Amplification 96251 (+317), Life Reinforcement 96252 (+379), Strengthen Resolve 96253 (+463), Superior Health Augmentation 96254 (+581), Temporary Cellular Enhancement 96255 (+644), Enhanced Health Surge 96257 (+928), Constitution Magnification 96256 (+1017), Health Assembler 96258 (+1123), Superior Life Reinforcement 96259 (+1234), Life Channeler 96247 (+1344). source=local

selfBuffs.name: Vaccine of Divestiture
selfBuffs.effect: Resist nano strains 135 and 136 at 26%, and strain 147 at 15% (the Trader Ransack/Deprive drain family).
selfBuffs.note: Top of a 4-step level-gated line: Vaccine of Ransacking 204425 (level 75, 14%/3%), Vaccine of Deprivation 204427 (level 100, 17%/6%), Vaccine of Plundering 204429 (level 155, 21%/10%), Vaccine of Divestiture 204431 (level 195, 26%/15%). Same nanoline - only the best applies. Anti-Trader tech; keep up in PvP and in any fight with draining mobs. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Pistol Mastery
selfBuffs.note: NOTE the cast requirement: this nano is castable by Soldier(1), Engineer(3), Bureaucrat(8), Doctor(10) AND Meta-Physicist(12) - it is a shared nano that appears in the Doctor's castable set, not a Doctor exclusive. A Doctor uses it on itself to wield a higher-QL pistol. Do NOT confuse it with the SL group perk line also called Pistol Mastery (+59 Pistol / +6 Fling Shot / +16 all damage modifiers at 5 tiers). source=local

selfBuffs.name: Encode DNA Sequence
selfBuffs.note: Travel. The ExpansionPlayfield == 0 requirement means Rubi-Ka only - it will not fire in Shadowlands. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Tjernberg Soothing Adrenaline
selfBuffs.effect: ReduceNanoStrainDuration[883, 1000000] - collapses the duration of nano strain 883 on the target.
selfBuffs.note: A targeted strain-duration wipe with a very low skill requirement. Which effect strain 883 is was NOT resolved here - see _unverified. source=local

wantedFromOthers.buff: Composite Mochams (all six nano skills +140) and the single Mocham's Gift: BioMet / MatMet
wantedFromOthers.effect: +140 to every nano skill in one nano (Composite, 1 NCU slot), or +140 to one school with the singles.
wantedFromOthers.note: THE buff a Doctor wants above all others. +140 BM and +140 MM is often exactly one rung up the heal ladder - it is the difference between Team Health Plan (270349, BM 873) and the tier below, or between being able to self-cast Complete Healing (28650, BM 794) and not. Also counts toward the nano-skill requirements on symbiants. Ask an MP for Composite Mochams (or the six singles) before every raid. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Wrangle (Shark line: Ransack / Dominate the Weak -> single or team Wrangle)
wantedFromOthers.effect: Adds to ALL weapon skills AND all nano skills at once, single up to roughly +132. Short duration; self-debuffs the Trader.
wantedFromOthers.note: The equip window. A Doctor uses a wrangle to put on the next symbiant or implant QL and to reach a heal tier it cannot normally cast. Stacks with the MP's Mochams (different nanolines). NOTE the irony: the Doctor's own Vaccine line (204425-204431) exists to RESIST the Trader's drains - a friendly Trader's wrangle is still wanted. source=web

wantedFromOthers.effect: Sustained team version that refreshes without debuffing the Trader.
wantedFromOthers.note: Keeps the whole raid, including the Doctor's nano skills, elevated for the fight. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Essence of Behemoth line (Improved Essence of Behemoth etc.)
wantedFromOthers.effect: Strength and Stamina together (Improved roughly +54 each) plus a large Max Health boost.
wantedFromOthers.note: Specifically valuable to a Doctor because its own endgame armor is Stamina-gated: Ofab Doctor QL300 requires Stamina 1099 and Chosen/Faithful Doctor QL300 requires Stamina 1099 (read from items.ocp). Different nanoline from the Doctor's own Iron Circle (Who_Buffs_What puts Essence on line 151 and Iron Circle on 156), so the two stack. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Extra NCU (Grid Armor / NCU nanos) + team run speed + heal-over-time
wantedFromOthers.effect: Raises Max NCU, gives team run speed and a HoT.
wantedFromOthers.note: NCU is the Doctor's binding constraint - it is running team HP buff, Iron Circle, Instinctive Control, Nano Repulsor and a vaccine before anyone else offers anything. More NCU is directly more uptime. The Funcom teaming guide's warning applies to everyone ELSE: 'do not give the doc any of your profession's often sought after buffs unless she asks for them... she is probably trying to keep 200 NCU free'. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Feline Grace (+25 Agility) and Enhanced Senses (+15 Sense)
wantedFromOthers.effect: Agility and Sense for equip requirements.
wantedFromOthers.note: Ability requirements on implants and Support symbiants. source=web

Pharma Tech is cost factor 1.0 for a Doctor and is the tradeskill it is expected to be good at (AO-Universe: 'Doctors have a particular tradeskill they are good with, specifically PhamaTech'). Stacks on top for building stims and health kits. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Robust Treatment / Eagle Eye (Treatment and Perception) plus run speed
wantedFromOthers.effect: Treatment (Robust roughly +60), Perception (Eagle Eye roughly +240), strong run-speed buffs.
wantedFromOthers.note: Treatment stacks on top of the Doctor's OWN Superior First Aid (+80 Treatment) for the implant/symbiant ladder. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Keeper auras (run speed, healing, Add All Offense, damage reflect)
wantedFromOthers.effect: Passive team auras including a heal aura and reflect.
wantedFromOthers.note: The reflect and the heal aura reduce the incoming damage the Doctor has to out-heal - a genuine force multiplier for a healer, not just a stat stick. source=web

wantedFromOthers.buff: Team AC and Add-All-Defense buffs; enemy nano-resist debuffs
wantedFromOthers.effect: Team defensive buffs; debuffs that make hostile nanos land more easily.
wantedFromOthers.note: The nano-resist debuff side helps the Doctor land UBT on a resistant boss. Exact nano names not pinned - see _unverified. source=web(flag)

generalBuffs.effect: Instant self-heal and nano refill, gated by First Aid and Treatment respectively.
generalBuffs.source: Consumables. For a Doctor this is the one instant heal that does not use a nano cast - which matters because everything else it does is a cast. First Aid and Treatment are both cost factor 1.0 for a Doctor (skillcaps.json), so it can use the highest-QL kits in the game.

preFightCastOrder: 1. Team HP buff - the best rung of the 16-step line you can cast (Superior Omni-Med Enhancement 95709 at the top). Lasts up to an hour, so it goes up first and stays up.
2. Iron Circle 42400 on the whole team (Strength +20 / Stamina +20).
3. Improved Instinctive Control 222856 on yourself and on every caster in the team (Nano C. Init +350).
4. Continuous Reconstruction 222824 (Heal Delta +65) on the team while out of combat.
5. Improved Nano Repulsor 222823 and the best Vaccine (204431 down to 204425) when the content or the opponent casts at you.
6. Life Channeler 96247 (or the best short HP buff you can cast) on yourself and the tank immediately before the pull - it lasts only ~8m20s, so it is a pull-timer buff, not a standing one.
7. Superior First Aid 28675 before anyone twinks gear.
inFightPriority: 1. Land the best unbreakable initiative debuff on the mob (UBT 99577, else Rapid Palsy 301845). Less incoming damage beats more outgoing heals.
2. Keep a HoT rolling on the tank (Deathless Blessing 43852, or Team-Enhanced Deathless Blessing 269455 in AoE fights).
3. Spot-heal with the single-target ladder; the top SL rungs are level-gated (Bodily Invigoration 223299 at 220, Cellular Rebirth 223297 at 218).
4. Team-heal when two or more are hurt (Superior Team Health Plan 273312 / Distributed Care 43892 - AOWiki rates Distributed Care best on heal-per-second).
5. HOLD Complete Healing 28650 / Improved 270747 for a spike, and Alpha and Omega 42409 for a team-wide spike. They are resets.
6. Only when nobody needs healing: stack one DoT from each of the three strains (DOT_LineA, DOT_LineB, DOTStrainC) - Wrack and Ruin 28640 first for its -100 attack-skill debuff.
nanolineStackingTraps: Instinctive Control 28669 and Improved Instinctive Control 222856 share nanoline InitiativeBuffs - only the best applies. Never cast both.
Nano Repulsor 28671 and Improved Nano Repulsor 222823 share nanoline NanoResistanceBuffs - only the best applies.
Iron Circle 42400 and Enlarge 28658 share nanoline StrengthBuff - only the best applies.
Enhanced First Aid 28657, Specialist Treatment 28674 and Superior First Aid 28675 all share nanoline FirstAidAndTreatmentBuff - cast only the best.
Natural Healing 28663, Cellular Restoration 28651, Hearty Constitution 222855 and Continuous Reconstruction 222824 all share nanoline HealDeltaBuff - cast only the best.
All four Vaccines (204425/204427/204429/204431) share nanoline Ransack_DepriveResistBuff - cast only the best you are level-eligible for.
All 14 short HP buffs share nanoline DoctorShortHPBuffs - one per target at a time.

CROSS-PROFESSION TRAP: Who_Buffs_What puts both the Enforcer Essence line and the Soldier HP buffs on nanoline 151. A bot should not assume an Enforcer buff and a Soldier buff on the same target stack - take whichever is larger.
The Doctor's own Iron Circle is nanoline 156, a DIFFERENT line from Essence (151), so Iron Circle DOES stack with an Enforcer's Essence.
ncuBudget: The Doctor runs more standing buffs than almost any class: team HP buff + Iron Circle + Improved Instinctive Control + Improved Nano Repulsor + a Vaccine + a heal-delta buff, all on itself, before anyone else offers anything.

Who_Buffs_What gives Iron Circle alone as 26 NCU. The Funcom teaming guide's rule for TEAMMATES is that they should not push their buffs onto a Doctor unbidden: 'she is probably trying to keep 200 NCU free'.

A bot playing a Doctor should therefore treat NCU as a budgeted resource and should NOT auto-accept offered buffs. Computer Literacy is cost factor 1.0 for a Doctor and the Internship research line raises NCU - both are worth spending on.
froobCeiling: A free account has no Shadowlands, so a froob Doctor CANNOT cast: Improved Instinctive Control 222856, Team-Enhanced Deathless Blessing 269455 or any of the level-gated 2232xx single heals (all carry Expansion BitAnd 2).
No Lost Eden means no Misdiagnosis 266306 (Expansion BitAnd 32) and no research procs.

The nanos with a NanoFocusLevel BitAnd 64 requirement (Improved Complete Healing 270747, Improved/Superior Team Health Plan 273315/273312, Team Improved Life Channeler 275011, Malpractice 275701) are endgame Nano Focus content and are out of reach as well.

What a froob Doctor still has is the whole core: Complete Healing 28650, Alpha and Omega 42409, 36 of the 38 team heals, all 16 team HP buffs, all 14 short HP buffs, the full HoT ladder, Iron Circle, Instinctive Control 28669, Nano Repulsor 28671, Superior First Aid 28675, Epsilon Purge 28659 and UBT 99577. That is still the best healing kit in the game.

The heal amounts for the 38 team heals and 16 team HP buffs are NOT in this file, because each of those nanos only carries a TeamCastNano pointer to a child nano (e.g. Superior Omni-Med Enhancement 95709 -> 95673) and the children are not in the Doctor's own castable extraction. Who_Buffs_What's ranges (+26 to +920 Max Health for the team HP line) are quoted as web values, not local ones. Resolving them properly means re-reading the child nano ids out of nanos.ocp.

'Complete heals will always heal for 10001 health, ignoring heal modifying buffs' is AOWiki's statement. The local effect summary for Complete Healing (28650) and Improved Complete Healing (270747) is Hit[27,100,0,0], which does NOT obviously encode 10001 - the argument encoding for that function was not decoded. Treat the 10001 figure as web-sourced.

Cross-profession buff ids are null throughout - they belong to other professions and are not in the local Doctor nano data. Values (Wrangle ~+132, Essence ~+54, Feline Grace +25, Enhanced Senses +15, Robust Treatment ~+60, Eagle Eye ~+240) are Who_Buffs_What / ao-universe figures.
The claim that the Enforcer Essence line and the Soldier HP-buff line share nanoline 151 (and therefore do not stack) comes from a single reading of Who_Buffs_What. Verify before a bot relies on it.
Bureaucrat and Fixer exact buff nano names and values for a Doctor were not pinned to a specific source.

Misdiagnosis (266306) and Fill Inbox (266303) both carry TWO Profession EqualTo requirements in the local data (266306: 6 and 10; 266303: 10 and 8). These were read as 'castable by either profession', which matches how the extractor treats a requirement set - but the OR/AND grouping of those criteria was not verified from the raw action tree.
Durations are quoted from AOWiki (short HP buffs 'up to 8 minutes 20 seconds', long/team HP buffs 'up to an hour'); no duration field was read from the local nano data.
The Doctor's DoT damage figures shown in doctor-nanos.json are per-tick Hit values; tick count and total damage were not derived, so no DoT DPS comparison is attempted here.
